Use this when a vendor's certificate of insurance (COI) is about to expire or already has, and you want them to send a new one.

## Before you start
- Board members and admins can do this.
- The vendor needs a **Primary email** and a COI expiry date entered on their compliance check.
- The app never emails a vendor about insurance on its own. You decide when to ask.

## Steps
1. Find vendors to chase: the dashboard's Daily Digest and **At risk this week** list COIs expiring within 30 days and ones that have expired, and the board gets a notification in the bell 30 days and 7 days before and on the day.
2. Open the vendor's page. A notice at the top shows **Insurance expiring** or **Insurance expired**.
3. Select [[Request updated certificate]]. You can also find it on the **Compliance** card at any time.
4. Read the drafted email. It shows who it goes to, says when the certificate expires and lists your insurance minimums. Edit the subject or message if you like.
5. Select [[Send to vendor]].

## What happens next
The email goes to that vendor's email on file, from your association, asking them to reply with the certificate attached. It's recorded in **Messages**, on the **Sent to residents** tab.

When the new certificate arrives, open the vendor, upload it and enter the new dates and amounts, then select [[Run compliance check]]. The expiring notice clears once the new date is more than 30 days away.

## If something goes wrong
- **No email on file**: open the **More vendor actions** menu, choose **Edit details**, add a **Primary email**, then try again.
- "Sending to this address is blocked by the outbound safety guard": this is a test or sandbox account, so nothing was sent.
- "The email provider didn’t accept the message": nothing was sent. Try again later.
- "Couldn’t send the request. Try again.": nothing was sent. Try again.

## Good to know
- The email only ever goes to that vendor's address on file. Residents never get it, and you can't change the recipient.
- Nothing is sent until you select [[Send to vendor]]. Closing the window discards your edits.
- Only active and prospect vendors are listed as expiring. An inactive vendor's old certificate doesn't count.
